findings.title: A differentiated, mercy-directed arrival
findings.claim: Against wider scenes where disbelievers are driven to Hell in groups and the God-conscious are brought to Paradise and welcomed in groups, 19:85's gathering of al-muttaqin toward al-Rahman as wafdan becomes a distinct, mercy-directed audience before the day's sovereign.
findings.mechanism: The focus's nashuru gathers a named group toward an endpoint, and wafdan gives their manner the shape of a delegation. Wider scenes in 39:71 and 39:73 provide contrasting group routes; 25:26 identifies al-Rahman as sovereign on that Day, while 78:38 makes speech before him permissioned. The supplied Fatiha context at 1:3 pairs al-Rahman with al-Rahim. These independent scenes return through the focus's gathering act, guarded group, delegation, and mercy-name, changing a generic future assembly into a differentiated reception at a merciful authority.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear why this is not simply a crowd being gathered: the guarded group approaches the Merciful as a delegated party, within a wider field where group arrivals have different destinations and access to speech is governed by the sovereign.
findings.containment: The focus's plain assertion remains intact: God gathers the God-conscious toward al-Rahman as a delegation. The parallels do not prove identical membership, a causal sequence, or that this particular party speaks, petitions, or intercedes. The supplied focus analysis marks wafdan as an indefinite accusative circumstantial state; the interpretation does not turn that manner into an unstated speech act. Wider connection records supply target Arabic but not target morphology, so their contribution is bounded to the visible scenes and wording.

epistemic.reason: The cited cross-run publication is trusted and the focus branches are accepted records. The connection records supply exact target Arabic and specific relation notes, but not target morphology or lexical analysis; the contextual interpretation therefore remains bounded to those visible scenes.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Birden çok kişiyi bulundukları yerden çıkararak aynı hedefe doğru sevk edip toplama.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus verb nashuru carries gathering or mustering a group toward a destination.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied wider scenes depict disbelievers driven toward Hell in groups (39:71) and people who fear their Lord brought to Paradise in groups and welcomed (39:73).
branch_activations.activation: These distinct group routes meet the focus's gathering act and its stated direction toward al-Rahman; the outside scenes make the focus's mode and destination a meaningful contrast rather than an undifferentiated assembly.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The God-conscious are gathered in a particular, honored reception, while other group arrivals have different destinations and manners.
branch_activations.boundary: The connection records give target Arabic but no target morphology; the comparison does not establish that the groups are identical or that every gathering has the same sense.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: korkulan şeyden ya da yanlış davranıştan kendini koruma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Öz-koruma, kişiyi suç doğuran ve yanlış sayılan davranışlardan uzak tutma biçimini alabilir.
branch_activations.carrier: Al-muttaqin names the people characterized by guarding themselves from harm or wrong conduct.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider pair contrasts disbelievers driven to Hell (39:71) with those who fear their Lord and are welcomed at Paradise (39:73).
branch_activations.activation: The focus's self-guarding class meets an external contrast in final reception; the wider scenes make the protective orientation consequential to how the group arrives.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The guarded quality of al-muttaqin is heard as more than a label: it marks the group whose approach is associated with a favorable welcome rather than the penal route.
branch_activations.boundary: The verses do not establish that the focus's group is exactly coextensive with the group in 39:73, or that every member is protected from all harm.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: korkulan şeyden ya da yanlış davranıştan kendini koruma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Tanrı'ya karşı gelmekten sakınma, kişi ile sakınılan sonuç arasına koruyucu bir tutum koymak olarak düşünülür.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus names the God-conscious as a group defined through self-guarding before God.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider scenes distinguish those who fear their Lord and are welcomed from disbelievers whose group is driven to Hell.
branch_activations.activation: The explicit fear-of-Lord group and the contrasting disbelievers give the focus's protective orientation a concrete relation to opposing God and to the resulting route.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The delegation image carries a contrast between guarded approach to God and a rejected, penal arrival.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a contextual contrast, not a claim that the focus states the members' complete conduct or that the groups in the parallel verses are the same people.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bu iç yöneliş, acınan kişiyi esirgemeyi ve ona iyilikte bulunmayı gerektiren etkin bir sonuç taşır.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied wider context at 1:3 pairs al-Rahman with al-Rahim.

branch_activations.boundary: The name-level contact does not specify a particular act, measure, or recipient of mercy, and it does not imply intercession.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: hükümdara elçi ya da dilek sahibi olarak varma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi ya da topluluk, belirli bir amaçla hükümdarın huzuruna gelir.
branch_activations.carrier: Wafdan names the focus group's manner as a delegation or envoy-party approaching al-Rahman.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider scene at 25:26 assigns sovereignty on that Day to al-Rahman; at 78:38, speaking before him depends on his permission.
branch_activations.activation: The focus's delegated arrival meets the wider sovereign and permissioned-audience scenes; the group approaches an authority rather than merely occupying a location.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Wafdan is heard as a formal audience before the sovereign of that Day.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not identify what the group seeks or say that they speak; the wider scene does not identify this party as its speakers.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: hükümdara elçi ya da dilek sahibi olarak varma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Gelen kişi elçi olabilir veya bir dileğinin yerine getirilmesini isteyebilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus's wafdan is a collective party coming to al-Rahman as a delegation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider Day scene says that no one speaks before al-Rahman unless he permits it and the speaker says rightly (78:38).
branch_activations.activation: A formal party arriving before the same sovereign meets an independent scene of permissioned speech; this makes the envoy or petitioner face of the delegation intelligible while leaving the actual speech act unstated.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The delegation can be heard as an envoy-like audience whose access is governed by al-Rahman's permission.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not say these people speak, petition, advocate, or intercede; the parallel only bounds how far the audience image may be taken.
